cue.definition: hard item whose state contains a quoted conclusion attributed to a person/role (note, comment, remark, draft, recommendation, message...); regex in drivers/gap_cue.py

a7_rate_method.loose_hits_read: A7g: a numeric field named 'draft'; A7o/A7p: one-line unattributed 'Claim: record X has value Y' verification rows; A7h/A7m: reported speech in natural text and NLI pairs. None is a role-attributed case conclusion inside a decision packet.
a7_rate_method.refinement: A7o/A7p train short unattributed claim verification (8-32% of rows), the nearest relative of the planted-quote skill, but in one-to-two-line states
a7_rate_method.strict: same regex on a seeded reservoir sample of 4,000 rows per A7 arm train.jsonl (A7k: all 2,190) from two cached snapshots of the training-data repository; share of states with a match; max 0.97% (A7h)

audit_selection.rule: hard or standard with p<.15; plus any item where >=3 of 7 strong models (Eikos-27B, AutoJev-27B, JPT-4B, JPT-9B, F1, C0, Decider 4B) agree on the same non-gold answer with confidence >=.8

consensus_nongold_defensible.why_not: each shared wrong answer traces to one missed step: unconditional instead of conditional base rate; skipped aggregation rule; trusting a tool summary line; next override window instead of the current one; accepting a response with an arithmetic error

difficulty.p_definition: share of 66 distinct models correct (stats helper item_stats.json, all_distinct)

grades.method: each item read privately and the gold recomputed from the stated rules (arithmetic, date/time, counting and precedence steps redone by hand or with a scratch calculation)

planted_quote_among_audited.manual_reading: 12/20 (12 of the 15 non-judge items; judge_hard items have none, the judged response itself is the claim to check)

planted_quote_flag_method.implication: the flag undercounts; quote/no-quote contrasts are diluted, not inflated

spot_check.false_positive: a quoted customer request that states no conclusion
spot_check.misses: reported speech without a listed keyword, chat transcript without quote marks, paraphrased note inside a dict state, a team working-assumption line

planted_quote_flag_method.type: heuristic regex (drivers/gap_cue.py): role/utterance keyword, then a colon or comma and an opening quote within 80 characters

labels.N4XF: DEV2.0-4B (released package re-score rel-4b is identical)

scope: public 231 item-level gap analysis; aggregates only

v3_vs_public_correlation_36_distinct_run.method: Pearson; duplicates (8k/16k renders, release re-scores, N5-ref, F0) removed
